name: New Guomai Digital Culture Co., Ltd.
summary: New Guomai Digital Culture Co., Ltd. engages in digital content, digital intelligence applications, points redemption, and other internet-related businesses in China. It is involved in the collection, production, broadcasting, and viewing of digital content; digital intelligence travel, party building, and exhibitions; and government and enterprise industry information technology solutions. The company also operates a points platform with unified operation, management, and settlement; and offers digital creative solutions and creative sharing space for enterprises and C -end user. In addition, it engages in e-commerce, communications, hotel management and operations, and tourism businesses; and operation of online video, e- book, animation video, online game, and app store. The company was founded in 1983 and is based in Shanghai, China. New Guomai Digital Culture Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of China Telecom Group Co., Ltd.
